_readme: Settings for 'Search the Monastery' (دوّر في الدير), the hidden-letters game at the desert monastery. Change numbers here; no code change needed. letterCounts: the levels (how many letters hide). phoneLetters: phones (shortest screen side under smallScreenWidth) skip the picker and always hide this many, with no brothers. heroRunMs: how long the brother takes to reach a found letter. nameBubbleMs: how long the letter's name stays in the bubble. hintGlowMs: how long a hint's glow pulses. tapRadius: how forgiving a tap is (1 = about the letter's size). minSpotGap: two letters never hide closer than this (in scene heights). maxRotation: letters lean up to this many degrees either way. letterColors: muted colours that blend with the scene; each letter gets one at random. letterOpacity: 1 = solid. showSpots: true draws every hiding spot as a dashed circle, to line spots up with new art (keep false for kids). scene: everything in it is in fractions of the scene picture (x of its width, y of its height, 0 = top left). scene.aspect: the picture's width / height. scene.background: the room picture without the objects (drawn in code when null). scene.objects: things standing in front of the letters, each a cut-out picture (image, transparent PNG) placed at rect [x, y, width, height]; without an image the 'shape' is drawn in code. scene.spots: where a letter can hide (its centre x, y and size as a fraction of the scene height). Letters are drawn behind every object, so put a spot on an object's edge to show only part of the letter. Every game picks random spots and random letters.
